reason.evidence.sourced: [ES] It is backed by published injury statistics, linked under Sources.
reason.evidence.verify: [ES] We are still double-checking the numbers behind this one, so treat its place in the list as a best estimate.
reason.unlock: [ES] This risk starts in about {months} months, so it is a good time to get ahead of it.
reason.unlock.one: [ES] This risk starts in about a month, so it is a good time to get ahead of it.
reason.cost: [ES] Fixing it costs about ${min} to ${max}, and cheaper fixes rank a little higher when everything else is equal.
reason.cost.free: [ES] The main fixes cost nothing, and cheap or free fixes rank a little higher when everything else is equal.

help.title: [ES] Help
help.poisonText: [ES] Free, 24 hours a day. Call right away if a child may have swallowed something harmful. Don't wait for symptoms.
help.call911: [ES] If a child isn't breathing, can't be woken or is having a seizure, call 911.
help.soon: [ES] Checked Texas resources will be listed here.
people.title: [ES] People
people.soon: [ES] Sharing isn't ready yet. It will arrive in an update.
people.noHelpers: [ES] Names you assign to tasks will show up here.
settings.title: [ES] Settings
settings.eraseText: [ES] This removes your children, homes and task progress from this phone. You can't undo it.
privacy.title: [ES] Privacy and how this works
privacy.1: [ES] Everything you enter stays on this device. There are no accounts and no tracking.
privacy.2: [ES] Advice comes from linked sources that people reviewed. AI does not write it.
privacy.3: [ES] The app can't see your home, so it can't tell you a hazard is gone. Check each fix yourself.
privacy.aiTitle: [ES] How AI helped build this app
privacy.aiText: [ES] AI tools helped write this app's code. They did not write the advice. The project logs its AI use in the AI_USE file.
